plan.title: Fly (new VM) in the Machine field and --machine fly: neither PAN-4651 nor PAN-4652 delivers it
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-4811 (lanes on a new Fly VM, follow-up)

metadata.sizeJustification: One feature across its fixed callers: the Fly target door, the resolver branch, the conversation route, the Machine field and Settings dialog, the CLI sentence, and the docs. The subsystem count is inflated because each top-level doc file (cli/machines.mdx, configuration/linked-machines.mdx, docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md, .overdeck/context) and each test root counts as its own subsystem; the code itself spans src/dashboard, src/cli and src/lib. Splitting off the Settings dialog or the docs would recreate the ownership gap this issue exists to close.

narratives.Problem: PAN-4651 deferred Fly (new VM), --machine fly and remote.auto_fly to PAN-4652, and PAN-4652 deferred them back to PAN-4651. Both merged: resolveTargetMachine refuses 'fly' with 'Fly (new VM) needs PAN-4652', the CLI refuses the same way, the Machine field shows the choice disabled, Settings has no Add-a-Fly-machine entry, and no code reads remote.auto_fly.
narratives.Proposal: Add a Fly target door (startFlyTarget in services/fleet-fly-target.ts) that checks admin, project, GitHub origin and needs, calls addFlyMachine with the project, and returns a FleetTarget for the new link with a discard hook. resolveTargetMachine routes 'fly' to it when the route passes a spawn context, and Auto falls back to it when remote.auto_fly is true and no machine fits. Only POST /api/fleet/conversations passes a spawn context, so the Machine field's Fly (new VM) works; the conversation still starts through the owner's work door. Workers, issue starts and lanes refuse 'fly' with accurate sentences because a new VM cannot safely hold them today (idle sweep, no workspace, lane launch order). Add the Add-a-Fly-machine dialog and update the docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- pan start --machine fly (work agents on a new Fly machine) and Auto creating a VM for pan start: PAN-4734 owns Fly work agents; the idle sweep would destroy the VM under an agent-<issue> session today.
- pan worker run --machine fly: a worker needs its issue workspace, which a new VM never has.
- pan lane start --machine fly and gauntlet.fly.max_vms: PAN-4811.
- remote.auto_fly for workers, issue starts or lanes; it covers conversations only.
- Any change to the idle sweep, the spend cap, provisioning, addFlyMachine or POST /api/machines/fly behavior.
- Changes to MCP tool descriptions in src/lib/mcp/tools-write.ts.
- POST /api/fleet/placement or the CLI's Auto answering Fly.
- Region list, image, harness, model or first-message fields in the Add-a-Fly-machine dialog.
- A Settings UI control for remote.auto_fly.
- Fixing PAN-4740 or PAN-4741.

autoDecisions.summary: Fly (new VM) ships for conversations only; pan start / pan worker run / pan lane start --machine fly refuse with accurate sentences.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified on main: agent-<issue> rows are excluded from the shared list (conversations.ts:555) so the idle sweep (fly-machine-loops.ts:144-147) would destroy a new VM under a work agent; startWorker requires an existing issue workspace (worker/start.ts:130-131); launchLane resolves the machine before harness resolution and the one-live-lane check (launch.ts:412-450). Ownership recorded on PAN-4734 (comment) and PAN-4811 (new issue).

autoDecisions.summary: Only admin credentials may create a Fly VM through the fleet routes (403 fly-needs-admin otherwise); agent senders using the local internal token are allowed.
autoDecisions.rationale: POST /api/machines/fly needs admin (PAN-4652 D-14) because a VM costs money; fleet routes need only operate. Local agents hold the admin internal token and can already run pan machines add-fly, so refusing them would protect nothing.

autoDecisions.summary: remote.auto_fly is a config.toml [remote] boolean, default false, consulted only when no machine fits, for conversations, with a GitHub origin and needs within linux/docker.
autoDecisions.rationale: Epic D-19 step 2: 'Fly, unless remote.auto_fly: true and every other candidate is excluded'. [remote] keys live in config.toml and survive the config.yaml overlay.

autoDecisions.summary: A Fly machine created for a spawn that then fails is discarded at once via handleMachinesUnlink.
autoDecisions.rationale: Otherwise it holds a remote.max_concurrent_agents slot and costs money for machine_idle_minutes (default 30) until the idle sweep removes it.

autoDecisions.summary: The conversation on the new VM starts through the owner's work door, not startFlyConversation.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps one path for every linked machine: the caller's actor and agent fence, the git-origin project match and the immediate linked-list refresh.

autoDecisions.summary: The live Fly run is consent-gated through pan ask; browser UAT runs with remote.enabled false so it spends nothing.
autoDecisions.rationale: A real VM costs money; PAN-4652 set the same precedent.

items.title: Add the Fly target door startFlyTarget in services/fleet-fly-target.ts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create src/dashboard/server/services/fleet-fly-target.ts exporting FlySpawn, FlyTargetRequest, FLY_MACHINE_TAGS=['linux','docker'], FlyTargetDeps and startFlyTarget(request, deps=defaultFlyTargetDeps()). Add `discard?: () => Promise<void>` to the self:false variant of FleetTarget in fleet-target.ts (type only). Refuse in order with {code,error}: no admin (403 fly-needs-admin), no projectKey (400 fly-needs-project), gitOrigin null (409 project-has-no-origin), origin not starting github.com/ (409 project-not-on-github), needs outside FLY_MACHINE_TAGS (409 needs-unmet with missing). Then deps.addFly({projectKey, harness?, model?}); map FlyMachineError via FLY_MACHINE_ERROR_STATUS (from src/lib/anywhere/fly/provision.js), MachineLinkError via ERROR_STATUS (routes/machines.js), other errors 500 fly-failed. Find the stored MachineLink by result.link.id via deps.links(). discard() = deps.unlink(link.id), warning (never rethrowing) on failure. needs includes docker and record.docker false => discard + 409 needs-unmet missing ['docker']. Emit activity 'Added Fly machine "<label>" (<app>, <region>)'. Return {ok:true,self:false,link,environmentId,label:record.label,reason:'Fly (new VM) → <label> (<region>)',discard}. Defaults: addFly=(i)=>addFlyMachine(i,{notifyLinksChanged}), links=listLinks, unlink=handleMachinesUnlink(id), activity=emitActivityEntry, warn=console.warn('[fleet-fly] ...'). No execSync. Tests inject every dep.

items.title: Given a request whose mayCreate is false, startFlyTarget returns 403 with code fly-needs-admin and the addFly dependency is never called

Given addFly rejects with FlyMachineError('cap-reached', msg), startFlyTarget returns status 409 with body { code: 'cap-reached', error: msg }

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. In src/dashboard/server/routes/fleet-work.ts: FleetCaller gains `mayCreateFly?: boolean`; fleetCaller() sets it to credential !== null && credentialScopes(credential).includes('admin') on both return paths (computed before the ceiling drops admin). FleetSpawnDeps.resolveTarget gains optional `spawn?: FlySpawn`; defaultFleetSpawnDeps passes resolveTargetMachine(machine, gitOrigin, needs, defaultFleetTargetDeps(), spawn). handleFleetConversation passes { projectKey: projectKey ?? null, harness: options.harness, model: options.model, mayCreate: caller.mayCreateFly === true }. When the work door answer is not 201 with a name: if it is 503 with code machine-unreachable (the 30 s WORK_DOOR_TIMEOUT_MS or a hang-up, PAN-4740), do NOT discard — the conversation may be starting on the VM; answer 503 with error '<label> (new Fly machine) did not answer in time; it is still linked. Open it from the conversation list, or remove it with pan machines unlink <label>.' and leave the VM to the idle sweep. For any other non-201 answer, await target.discard?.() before ownerRefusal. handleFleetWorker, handleFleetIssueStart and routes/lanes.ts pass no spawn. Update the file header bullet.
